title: Understand taskweave JSON relation edges and downrank terminal tasks

sections.what: Teach json_parser.py REFERENCE_KEYS to extract taskweave relation edges (blocks, blocked_by, depends_on, supersedes, invalidates, related) across task files and downrank superseded/cancelled/done tasks in search results.
sections.why: Once repos store tasks as taskweave JSON files, similarity/keyword search across tasks otherwise treats terminal or invalidated cards equally with active work and misses task graph edges.
sections.how: Extend REFERENCE_KEYS / cross-file resolution in src/codesearch/parsers/json_parser.py for taskweave relation fields, and add status-aware score dampening in src/codesearch/search.py when task JSON nodes have superseded/cancelled status unless filtered explicitly.

acceptance.text: Extract taskweave relation arrays as cross-task CONNECTS_TO/REF edges in json_parser.py
Downrank superseded and cancelled task JSON nodes in default search ranking
Add unit tests covering relation edge extraction and terminal task ranking
